name: number-roll
title: Number Roll
description: Tabular digits that roll in the direction of change: a 9 → 0 carry rolls forward, a value that changes mid-roll redirects, new places fade in while the rest slide over. Intl formatting, locale-aware separators.

files.content:
"use client";

/**
 * Number Roll: tabular digits that roll in the direction of change, with locale-aware
 * separators. The engine is the shared `_primitives/number-roll` primitive that Badge,
 * Progress and the other Eased components roll their numbers with; this entry point is
 * the public import.
 *
 *   <NumberRoll value={48210.4} format={{ style: "currency", currency: "USD" }} />
 */
export {
  NumberRoll,
  toRollParts,
  type NumberRollFormat,
  type NumberRollProps,
  type RollDirection,
  type RollPart,
} from "../_primitives/number-roll/number-roll";

docs: Import NumberRoll from components/eased/number-roll/number-roll. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
